title: DigitalOcean Review 2026: Droplet Prices, WordPress Speed, Support and AI Tools
excerpt: DigitalOcean rents you a server from $4 a month, and you run it. Here is what backups add, how WordPress ran in four tests, and who should pick a managed host instead.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: DigitalOcean Review 2026: Droplet Prices, WordPress, AI
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: DigitalOcean review for 2026: Droplet prices from $4, backup costs, WordPress speed in four independent tests, the 99.99% SLA, support, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: DigitalOcean is a developer cloud with Droplets from $4 a month, not a managed WordPress host. Caching is essential for WordPress, backups add 20% to 30%, and chat support costs extra.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is DigitalOcean good for WordPress? | Yes if you can run a server and turn on caching. A $6 Droplet took 1.66 seconds to first byte without a cache and 0.40 seconds with one.
How much does DigitalOcean cost? | Basic Droplets start at $4 a month. A 2 GiB Droplet is $12, and a 4 GiB Droplet is $24.
Does DigitalOcean charge for backups? | Yes. Weekly backups add 20% and daily backups add 30% to the Droplet price.
Is there a DigitalOcean free credit? | New accounts get a $5 credit for 90 days, with no code needed.
What is the DigitalOcean uptime SLA? | 99.99% monthly uptime per Droplet, with a credit of 100% of that month's Droplet charges if missed.
Does DigitalOcean offer support? | Tickets are free and answered within a day, per WPThinker. Chat and Slack support need a paid plan, and DigitalOcean lists support plans from $0.
Is DigitalOcean managed hosting? | No. You run the server. Cloudways offers managed hosting on DigitalOcean servers.
How is DigitalOcean billed? | Per second since 1 January 2026, with a one-minute minimum and a cap at 672 hours a month on Basic Droplets.
Does DigitalOcean have AI products? | Yes. It lists Gradient AI Platform and GPU Droplets.
Which DigitalOcean Droplet is best for WordPress? | WPThinker calls $6 the smallest it would use, $12 good for a small business site and $24 good for a small store.
Does DigitalOcean have a renewal increase? | No. WPThinker says there is no intro discount, so the price stays the same.
Who should avoid DigitalOcean? | Beginners who want a managed host, and anyone who wants human chat support included.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Basic Droplets start at $4 a month, with no renewal increase.
A page cache cut first-byte time from 1.66 s to 0.40 s on a $6 Droplet.
Backups add 20% to 30%, and chat support costs extra.
The SLA is 99.99% with a credit, not a refund.
meta.rl_r_verdict: DigitalOcean is a good, steady server for developers and agencies who can run it. WordPress speed depends on caching, backups cost extra and chat support is paid. Choose a managed host if you do not want to run a server.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You are a developer or agency who can run a server.
You want steady prices and strong network speed.
You want to build AI or custom apps next to a site.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want a managed WordPress host.
You want human chat support included.
You want a simple setup.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Simple, steady prices from $4 a month.
Excellent network speed in tests.
Free tickets, and a $5 credit for new accounts.
A 99.99% SLA.
GPU and AI products for developers.
meta.rl_r_cons:
You manage the server yourself.
Backups cost 20% to 30% extra.
Slow WordPress without caching on cheap Droplets.
Chat support costs extra.
Powered-off Droplets still bill.
meta.rl_r_best: Developers and agencies who can run a server
